name: SDF11 field (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field in the Subaru Deep Field toward some of the most distant galaxies with confirmed distances, seen by Hubble.
label: sdf11-hubble
story: Hubble aimed here to catch several remote galaxies whose great distances had already been confirmed by their spectra. Their faint light helps tell how the earliest galaxies formed and how galaxies may have cleared the fog of the young universe.

claims.text: SDF11 is a WFC3/IR pointing of program 12616 in the Subaru Deep Field at this position
The program images spectroscopically confirmed galaxies, among the most distant known, in the Subaru Deep Field
Each pointing was chosen to cover several confirmed galaxies (at least 3)
The goal is to understand the earliest galaxy formation and the galaxies' contribution to cosmic reionization
The sample includes Lyman alpha emitters
